to add more than 400 EV charging stalls at Regency shopping centers across the U.S.
The new chargers are expected to increase Regency Centers' EV charging footprint by more than 20%, building on the 150+ stalls already operated by EVgo at Regency properties.
The rollout will cover retail centers in Colorado, Florida, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and other states, mainly at high-density, grocery-anchored locations.
Each new site can feature up to 24 high-power chargers, with charging speeds capable of delivering a full charge in as little as 15 minutes, depending on the vehicle.
The expansion strengthens EVgo's charging network while supporting Regency Centers' broader EV infrastructure and sustainability goals.

title: EVgo, Regency power up partnership with 400+ new EV charging stalls
